limitations.cpu: Renderer Worker wall-clock spans, including synchronous driver waits. Not CPU utilization.
limitations.gpu: Sparse EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 around actual mirror/main/overlay passes. External profilers may own the query.
limitations.presentation: Long Animation Frame timestamps are sparse browser evidence. Complete display presentation intervals and Electron compositor CPU are unavailable.
limitations.gpuBufferBytes: Unavailable through a supported renderer API. Dedicated validation uses instrumented WebGL allocations.
limitations.visibleObjects: Unique object IDs actually submitted to main/mirror/shadow passes, excluding preparation micro-draws. Counts span the union of those views.
limitations.heap: performance.memory is origin/process-specific. Worker heaps require separate CDP sampling.
